facts.fact: AI productivity gains are projected to add up to $4.4 trillion to the global economy, per a WebFX-cited figure the page links to.
facts.quote: With AI’s productivity gains projected to add up to a staggering [$4.4 trillion to the global economy](https://www.webfx.com/blog/marketing/ai-statistics/)

facts.fact: Programmatic DOOH ad spend is expected to reach $1.35 billion USD by 2027, according to an eMarketer forecast cited by the page.
facts.quote: ad spend expected to reach [$1.35 billion USD by 2027](https://forecasts-na1.emarketer.com/584b26021403070290f93a55/5f11e61dfd62d60758baa57c)

facts.fact: The first proper digital billboards were introduced in the United States around 2005, marking the start of DOOH advertising.
facts.quote: The journey of DOOH advertising [began around 2005](https://oaaa.org/resources/history-of-ooh/) when the first proper digital billboards were introduced in the United States.

facts.fact: By 2010 there were only about 2,000 digital billboards in the US.
facts.quote: By 2010, there were only about 2,000 digital billboards in the US.

facts.fact: The US has over 16,000 digital billboards, according to a Statista statistic cited by the page.
facts.quote: The US alone has over [16,000 digital billboards](https://www.statista.com/statistics/659381/number-billboards-digital-usa/).

facts.fact: The transition to programmatic DOOH began around 2018-2019, marking a shift from traditional direct buys.
DOOH advertising is a one-to-many channel that targets a placement and the audience around that location, rather than individuals via IP addresses as in traditional digital advertising.
facts.quote: DOOH advertising operates as a one-to-many channel, fundamentally different from traditional digital advertising, which often targets specific individuals through IP addresses.

facts.fact: In the page's multi-channel fitness app example, DOOH billboards display QR codes so passersby can scan and download the app directly.
facts.quote: These billboards display QR codes for passersby to scan and download the app directly.

facts.fact: In the page's example, mobile ads are served via geofencing to individuals near DOOH billboards and offer incentives such as a free trial.
facts.quote: Using geofencing technology, mobile ads are served to individuals within the vicinity of the DOOH billboards.

facts.fact: The page states that DOOH audience estimates currently rely on hard-coded values from third-party geo-services, which provide a rolling average of foot traffic around each placement.
facts.quote: Currently, audience estimates rely on hard-coded values from third-party geo-services, providing a rolling average of foot traffic around each placement.

facts.fact: The page describes the impression multiplier method, which estimates DOOH audiences from third-party geo-service foot-traffic averages, as limited by its lack of real-time data.
facts.quote: This method, known as the impression multiplier, is limited by its lack of real-time data.
